items.desc: In Walyalup for her national Villain tour, Narrm’s Simona Castricum blends new wave, electro-punk, industrial, techno and house, spanning 70s radio, 80s music television and underground club culture. Her fifth album, the Balearic-rock Villain, is out through Trans-Brunswick Express. She’s remixed Courtney Barnett, opened for DJ Hell and worked with Aérea Negrot. From queer basements and fetish clubs to Golden Plains, Strawberry Fields and the airwaves of 3RRR and Skylab Radio, Castricum moves between underground and festival dancefloors.
items.title: Guest Mix w/ Simona Castricum

items.desc: ‘Music My Friends Showed Me’ is hosted by Loz (Lauren Yim), with each episode dedicated to a different friend. This episode is for Lulu, bringing together music she’s shared with Loz, songs that complement those selections and tracks tied to shared memories. Moving through soul, funk, disco and downtempo grooves, the show celebrates sharing music, the connections that grow from it and the feelings we share.

items.desc: It’s nearly the sun season of Scorpio (23 Oct - 22 Nov) and we are going DEEP in the underworld on Pleiades w/ Astro Tash. Subterranean inclinations permeate into every corner with deep minimal techno, acid jazz trips and hypnotic house rhythms the translator for this illuminating season. Things might feel a little topsy-turvy with Mercury joining Venus in retrograde (or upgrade?) through Scorpio; expect secrets to be revealed, truths realised and mysteries solved…. Let Pleiades be the guiding light in the dark.
items.title: PLEIADES [Scorpio Season] w/ Astro Tash - EP 4
